text: Understanding databases is essential for managing information effectively. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables, which organize information into rows and columns. To retrieve data, you use queries, which are special commands that ask the database for specific information. Data modeling helps you plan how data is organized and connected before you build anything. Indexes are another important feature—they work like a book's index and make searching through large amounts of data much faster. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, are more flexible and useful for unstructured data. Choosing the right type depends on your needs.
